scripts.build:example: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @pwa-instructions/example-react
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @pwa-instructions/example-react
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspace @pwa-instructions/example-react && npm test
scripts.pack:package: npm run build:packages && npm pack --workspace pwa-instructions
